dashboard.label: Query Tester — Monitoring
dashboard.description: Operations dashboard — test execution, scheduling, errors, and system health.

search.query: index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="scheduled_runner" message="Scheduled test * completed:*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="query_tester" message="Manual test run completed:*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" log_level="ERROR" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count
index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="scheduled_runner" message="Skipping *" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*duration=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "duration=(?<dur_ms>\d+)ms" | stats avg(dur_ms) as avg_ms | eval avg_ms=round(avg_ms/1000,1)." s"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" module="scheduled_runner" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval stage=case( like(message, "SHC stagger:%"), "1. Stagger delay", like(message, "Missed run detected for test%"), "2. Missed run sweep", like(message, "Enqueued test %") OR like(message, "%-run sweep enqueued%"), "3. Enqueued", like(message, "Processing % queued test%"), "4. Processing", like(message, "Skipping %"), "5. Skipped (dedup/SHC)", like(message, "Running scheduled test %"), "6. Running", like(message, "Scheduled test % completed:%"), "7. Completed", like(message, "Resetting stale%"), "X. Stale reset", log_level="ERROR", "X. Error", 1=1, "—") | where stage!="—" | stats count as "Events" latest(_time) as last_seen by stage | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort stage | rename last_seen as "Last Seen"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" (module="query_tester" OR module="core.test_runner" OR module="spl.query_executor" OR module="data.data_indexer" OR module="spl.query_injector") earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval stage=case( like(message, "Manual test run started by%"), "1. Started", like(message, "Cache macro scan:%"), "2. SPL analysis", like(message, "Indexed batch %"), "3. HEC indexing", like(message, "Executed SPL in %"), "4. Query executed", like(message, "Manual test run completed:%"), "5. Completed", like(message, "Scenario % failed:%"), "X. Scenario error", module="query_tester" AND log_level="ERROR", "X. Handler error", 1=1, "—") | where stage!="—" | stats count as "Events" latest(_time) as last_seen by stage | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort stage | rename last_seen as "Last Seen"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*status=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "status=(?<run_status>\w+)" | eval trigger=if(module="scheduled_runner", "Scheduled", "Manual") | eval label=trigger." — ".run_status | timechart count by label

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*status=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "status=(?<run_status>\w+)" | stats count by run_status

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*duration=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "duration=(?<dur_ms>\d+)ms" | eval bucket=case(dur_ms<2000,"<2s", dur_ms<10000,"2-10s", dur_ms<30000,"10-30s", dur_ms<60000,"30-60s", 1=1,"60s+") | eval order=case(bucket="<2s",1, bucket="2-10s",2, bucket="10-30s",3, bucket="30-60s",4, bucket="60s+",5) | chart count over bucket by module | sort order | fields - order

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" message="* completed:*duration=*" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | rex field=message "(?:test\s+(?<test_ref>[\w-]+)\s+)?completed:?\s*status=(?<run_status>\w+),?\s*duration=(?<dur_ms>\d+)ms" | eval dur_sec=round(dur_ms/1000, 1) | eval trigger=if(module="scheduled_runner", "Scheduled", "Manual") | sort - dur_ms | head 10 | table _time trigger test_ref run_status dur_sec | rename trigger as "Type", test_ref as "Test ID", run_status as "Status", dur_sec as "Duration (s)"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" (log_level="ERROR" OR log_level="WARNING") earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | stats count by module log_level | sort - count | head 20

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" log_level="ERROR" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | eval short_msg=if(len(message)>120, substr(message,1,120)."...", message) | stats count as "Count" latest(_time) as last_seen by short_msg module | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%m/%d %H:%M") | sort - Count | head 10 | rename short_msg as "Error", module as "Module", last_seen as "Last Seen"
| inputlookup saved_tests_lookup | eval type=case(validationType="ijump_alert","iJump", testType="query_only","Real Data", 1=1,"Synthetic") | chart count over app by type

| inputlookup scheduled_tests_lookup | eval status=if(enabled="1" OR enabled="true" OR enabled="True", "Enabled", "Disabled") | eval lastRun=if(lastRunAt="", "Never", strftime(strptime(lastRunAt, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), "%m/%d %H:%M")) | eval result=case(lastRunStatus="pass","Pass", lastRunStatus="fail","Fail", lastRunStatus="error","Error", 1=1,"—") | table testName app cronSchedule status result lastRun | sort - lastRun | rename testName as "Test", cronSchedule as "Cron", status as "State", result as "Last Result", lastRun as "Last Run"

| inputlookup test_run_history_lookup | sort - ranAt | head 30 | eval dur=round(durationMs/1000,1)." s" | eval drift=if(splDriftDetected="true" OR splDriftDetected="1", "Yes", "—") | eval ran=strftime(strptime(ranAt, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), "%m/%d %H:%M") | table ran ranBy triggerType status dur drift resultSummary | rename ran as "Time", ranBy as "User", triggerType as "Trigger", status as "Status", dur as "Duration", drift as "Drift", resultSummary as "Summary"

index=_internal source="*query_tester.log" log_level="ERROR" earliest=$time_range.earliest$ latest=$time_range.latest$ | sort - _time | head 20 | eval ts=strftime(_time, "%m/%d %H:%M:%S") | eval short_exc=if(isnotnull(exception), substr(exception,1,80)."...", "—") | table ts module message short_exc | rename ts as "Time", module as "Module", message as "Error", short_exc as "Exception"
